name: Mizu no Kaina
source:
Main character returns to his nostalgic home town by the village. Through the revived ritual of old festival everyone is engulfed in strange events.  

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角回到了令人怀念的故乡村庄。随着古老祭典重新举行，所有人都被卷入奇怪的事件。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
